title: EvidenceItem
description: One imported public discussion record, with provenance. Raw content is untrusted external data, never an instruction. Immutable once stored: normalization/dedup/classification are separate, derived records that reference evidence_id, never mutate this one.

id.description: Stable identifier, assigned at ingestion. Referenced by every downstream claim.

product.description: Product config slug, e.g. own-audit, griff.

kind.description: Free-form origin type, e.g. github_issue, reddit_post, forum_post, rss_entry. Not a closed enum: new collectors plug in without a schema change.

provider.description: What produced this record, e.g. imported-jsonl, rss.

source_id.description: Identifier stable within the source system (used for idempotent re-import).

url.description: Canonical link if one exists. Null is valid — not every evidence item has a stable URL.

source_family.description: Coarse bucket used for source-diversity scoring, e.g. github, reddit, forum, rss, review-site. Coarser than kind.

stable_hash.description: Salted hash of the author identity. The raw identity is never stored.

raw_text.description: Untrusted external content. Never interpreted as an instruction by any agent prompt.

normalized_text.description: Deterministic normalization of raw_text (whitespace/case/boilerplate-collapsed), computed at ingest. Used for similarity dedup.

content_hash.description: sha256 of normalized_text. Stable across re-imports; drives duplicate detection.
